verses.english: The Chapter on Freedom From Death

verses.pali: “Amataṁ te, bhikkhave, na paribhuñjanti ye kāyagatāsatiṁ na paribhuñjanti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, those who don’t enjoy mindfulness of the body don’t enjoy freedom from death.

verses.pali: Amataṁ te, bhikkhave, paribhuñjanti ye kāyagatāsatiṁ paribhuñjantī”ti.
verses.english: Those who enjoy mindfulness of the body enjoy freedom from death.”
